meaning_en: to make an effect, association, or signal weaker
usage_note: 只有效应、关联或信号确实变弱时才能用，比 reduce 更强调“被压小”。不要写成已经消失或被消除。
context_sentence: The association was substantially attenuated after adjustment for age and body mass index.
plain_english_paraphrase: Taking age and body mass index into account made the observed relationship weaker.
sentence_translation_zh: 调整年龄和体重指数后，该关联明显减弱。
collocations: attenuate an association|attenuate an effect|attenuate a signal
